name: Lattice
tagline: Complete 27-page Lattice system preserving its source composition and distinctive typography.

palette.description: Original source-specific colors, contrast, shapes and image treatments preserved throughout all pages.

typography.style: Original families Roboto, Roboto Mono, Carlito retained with embedded original source custom faces and official Google Fonts files. Source sizes, weights, line heights, tracking and text roles are preserved; file versions and hashes are recorded separately.

best_for: Technical products, data platforms, quantitative updates and clear engineering narratives.
avoid_for: Content that exceeds the original text frames; highly dense tables or long paragraphs should be split across matching layouts.
